clue.text: Chapter in story about striking display

indicators.note: in places the chapter's letter within the turned story
about here means turned round, so the word for story is read backwards

parts.note: a tale is a story

explanation.surface: A book chapter is about some spectacular show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns TALE into ELAT, and 'in' puts C inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Eclat is brilliant success or showy effect, a dazzling performance.

clue.text: Winning conclusion to Cockney's trial

parts.note: an end is a conclusion

indicators.note: Cockney speech drops the H at the start of words

parts.note: a hearing is a trial in court

explanation.surface: A trial in East London reaches a happy ending.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cockney's' drops the H of HEARING, giving EARING; Cockneys are working-class Londoners famous for dropping their aitches.
explanation.definitionFit: Winning, as in a winning smile, means charming and attractive.

clue.text: Second in new role, certainly not first

indicators.note: in puts the letter for second inside the rearranged word
new says the letters of role are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: An actor playing second fiddle in a new part is certainly not the lead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges ROLE as LOER, and 'in' puts S in it.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor who is beaten is plainly not the winner.

clue.text: One who prizes job as financial administrator

definitions.meaning: someone who treasures things, values them highly
an official in charge of an organisation's funds

explanation.definitionFit: One who treasures values things, and an officer looking after a club's money holds that title.

clue.text: Len's girl, a strangely communicative type

indicators.note: strangely says the letters of the three words before it are set out in an odd new order

explanation.surface: Len's girlfriend is oddly talkative.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strangely' rearranges LENS, GIRL and A; the apostrophe in Len's is ignored and its S is used.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who sends signals, by flag or lamp, is a person whose job is passing messages.

clue.text: From which some theatre-goers may get their cut

definitions.text: From which some theatre-goers may get their cut

parts.words: From which some theatre-goers may get their cut
parts.note: theatre-goers suggests a playhouse audience taking a share of something, but the theatre is the operating theatre and the patients are cut by a surgeon's blade

explanation.definitionFit: A scalpel is the small sharp knife a surgeon uses to make incisions in the operating theatre.

clue.text: Confused driving student enters in distinctive clothing

indicators.note: enters says the learner's letter goes inside the clothing word

parts.note: garbed means dressed, especially in characteristic attire
L is the learner plate on a British student driver's car

explanation.surface: A muddled learner driver turns up in odd clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A garbled message is mixed up and hard to make sense of.

clue.text: A nurse quietly accommodated in Poplar

indicators.note: accommodated in means the quiet letter is housed inside the nurse

parts.note: SEN was a State Enrolled Nurse in Britain
p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: A nurse is quietly given lodging in Poplar, a district of East London.
explanation.walkthrough: Poplar looks like the London district, but it is the tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The aspen is a kind of poplar tree with trembling leaves.

clue.text: He takes a lot of interest in sole, say, and other fish

definitions.text: He takes a lot of interest

indicators.note: say signals that the word for sole is to be heard as speech

parts.note: sole means lone, single
a shark is a fish, other than the sole the surface pretends is one

explanation.surface: Someone is very curious about the sole and other kinds of fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sole' looks like a fish, but means LONE, which 'say' turns into LOAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A loan shark is a moneylender charging exorbitant rates, so a lot of interest is literal.

clue.text: High-class doctor admitted to Burlington House dance

indicators.note: admitted to means the class and doctor letters go inside the institution

parts.note: Burlington House in London is the home of the RA, the Royal Academy of Arts
U means upper-class, socially acceptable
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A posh doctor gets into a ball at a grand London house.
explanation.definitionFit: The rumba is a Cuban ballroom dance.

clue.text: Poor condition of soldiers held by underworld couple

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, and his realm
RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
a couple is a pair

explanation.surface: Troops captured by a pair of gangsters are in bad shape.
explanation.definitionFit: A building in bad repair, neglected and crumbling, is in a poor state.

clue.text: Leading minister welcoming little girl's song in church

indicators.note: welcoming means the minister's letters take the girl's name in between them

parts.note: PM, Prime Minister, is the leading minister of a government
Sal is a short form of the girl's name Sally or Sarah

explanation.surface: The Prime Minister welcomes a little girl's singing in church.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical psalms are sacred songs sung or chanted in church services.

clue.text: Art mostly by recognised painters hanging on the wall

indicators.note: mostly means most of the word is kept, its last letter dropped

parts.note: RAs are Royal Academicians, painters honoured by the Royal Academy

explanation.surface: Artworks by distinguished painters are displayed on a wall.
explanation.definitionFit: An arras is a tapestry, named after the French town, used as a wall hanging.

clue.text: Only apes I disturbed in these islands

indicators.note: disturbed says the letters of the preceding words are jumbled up

explanation.surface: Only I disturbed the apes on these islands.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the Pacific island group stretching from Hawaii to New Zealand.

clue.text: Great person lacking time to be licentious

indicators.note: lacking says the great person's word loses the letter standing for time

parts.note: an immortal is someone of lasting fame, a great figure

explanation.surface: A great figure who runs out of time turns dissolute.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe behaviour that breaks moral rules, especially sexual ones.

clue.text: Sweetener from American fellow out East in crazy circle

indicators.note: in puts the American and fellow pieces inside the crazy circle

parts.note: mad means crazy

indicators.note: out says the east letter is put out of the fellow's word

parts.note: cove is old British slang for a fellow or chap
E is the compass abbreviation for east
O is shaped like a circle

explanation.surface: An American chap heads out East to find sugar in a mad crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' takes E from COVE to leave COV; 'in' puts US and COV inside MAD + O.
explanation.definitionFit: Muscovado is an unrefined brown sugar.

clue.text: Judge's title rejected by fat dunderhead

indicators.note: rejected means thrown back, so the judge's title is read backwards

parts.note: Lud, as in 'm'lud', is the way a British barrister addresses a judge
lard is pig fat

explanation.surface: A fat fool refuses to give a judge his proper title.
explanation.definitionFit: A dunderhead and a dullard are both a slow, stupid person.

clue.text: Disgusting hot meal, so badly cooked

indicators.note: badly cooked suggests the ingredients are mangled into a new form

explanation.surface: A hot meal that is poorly cooked is revolting.
explanation.definitionFit: Loathsome means causing hatred or disgust, utterly repellent.

clue.text: Remedial treatment for a set that may need drill

definitions.text: Remedial treatment for a set that may need drill

parts.words: Remedial treatment for a set that may need drill
parts.note: a set that needs drill sounds like a squad of soldiers to be trained, but the set is of teeth and the drill a dental one

explanation.definitionFit: Dentistry is the care and repair of teeth, often by drilling and filling.

clue.text: Boasting before short round of playing of an organ

indicators.note: before puts the boasting word ahead of the rest

parts.note: gas is empty boastful talk

indicators.note: short means the word is cut, losing its final letter

parts.note: a trick is one round of play in a card game

explanation.surface: A show-off talks before playing a short piece on the organ.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' cuts TRICK to TRIC, and 'before' puts GAS first.
explanation.definitionFit: Gastric means relating to the stomach, which is a bodily organ.

clue.text: Priceless mineral found in mountain pass

indicators.note: found in means the mineral sits inside the mountain pass

parts.note: a col is a pass between mountain peaks
mica is a mineral that splits into thin sheets

explanation.surface: A precious mineral is discovered up in a mountain pass.
explanation.definitionFit: Priceless used informally means hilariously funny.

clue.text: Need, in some quarters, to reduce tension

indicators.note: in puts the word for need between the compass letters

parts.note: S, E and N are compass points, or quarters
lack is a need or want

explanation.surface: Some regions need to ease off the pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: To loosen something taut, like a rope, is to lessen its tightness.

clue.text: Flag not right for this ship

indicators.note: not means the letter for right is left out of the flag word

parts.note: a streamer is a long narrow flag

explanation.surface: This flag is wrong for this vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A steamer is a steamship, a vessel driven by steam engines.

clue.text: There's no amateur lightweight in the scheduled events

parts.note: a pro, a professional, is by definition no amateur
a gramme is a very light unit of weight

explanation.surface: No amateur boxer at lightweight is on the fight card.
explanation.definitionFit: A programme is a planned sequence of items, the list of what will happen at an event.

clue.text: Downright chubby

definitions.meaning: blunt and direct, as in a flat, unqualified answer

explanation.definitionFit: A plump denial is a blunt, outright one; a plump figure is rounded and fleshy.

clue.text: Chief magistrate whose mate is reportedly rough

definitions.meaning: a chief officer of a town or district in medieval England
the female sandpiper whose male is the ruff, a word that sounds like rough

explanation.walkthrough: The ruff is a wading bird; the female of the species has a different name, which is also the word for an old local officer.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a medieval English local official and the female of the ruff, a wading bird.

clue.text: Greeting used around small island republic

indicators.note: around says the greeting goes round the island word

parts.note: hi is an informal greeting
an ait or eyot is a small island in a river

explanation.surface: Hello is said all round a small island state.
explanation.walkthrough: AIT, a small river island (chiefly in the Thames), is a crossword regular.
explanation.definitionFit: Haiti is a Caribbean country governed as a republic.

clue.text: Peaceful woman — one associated with Descartes

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
René Descartes was the French philosopher

explanation.surface: A calm woman is a friend of the French philosopher.
explanation.walkthrough: Irene was the Greek goddess of peace, and the name means peace.
explanation.definitionFit: The name comes from the Greek for peace, so a woman of that name is peaceful by origin.

clue.text: Wise to follow universal custom

indicators.note: to follow places the wise word after the other piece

parts.note: U is the film certificate for universal, suitable for all
sage means wise

explanation.surface: It is wise to follow a custom everyone keeps.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage is customary practice, the way things are habitually done.

clue.text: Part from fellow member concerned with medical specialism

parts.note: co- means joint or fellow, as in co-worker
an MP is a Member of Parliament
on means about or concerning
ENT is ear, nose and throat medicine

explanation.surface: A doctor's colleague, an MP, takes an interest in a branch of medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: A component is one element or piece making up a whole.

clue.text: Device for driving a short distance in suitable situation

indicators.note: in puts the short distance inside the word for suitable

parts.note: proper means suitable or appropriate, as in a fitting situation
an ell is an old measure of length, about a yard

explanation.surface: A golfer drives a short way when the lie is right.
explanation.walkthrough: ELL, an obsolete cloth measure, is a crossword regular.
explanation.definitionFit: A propeller is the spinning device that drives a ship or aircraft forward.

clue.text: Each displaying energy in a high degree

parts.note: E is the symbol for energy in physics
very means to a high degree, extremely

explanation.surface: Every one of them shows great energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Every and each both pick out all members of a group one by one.
